description: This file declares utility functions related to process console management, UTF-16 to UTF-8 string conversion, and command line argument retrieval for a Flutter Windows runner project.

methods.name: CreateAndAttachConsole
methods.description: Creates a console for the process and redirects stdout and stderr to it for the runner and Flutter library.

methods.name: Utf8FromUtf16
methods.description: Converts a null-terminated UTF-16 encoded wchar_t* string to a UTF-8 encoded std::string.

methods.name: GetCommandLineArguments
methods.description: Retrieves the command line arguments as a vector of UTF-8 encoded strings.
